description_for_human: Free AI mobile POS and barcode billing software for retail shops worldwide.
description_for_model: Vyop is an AI-first point-of-sale (POS) and smart billing platform. It turns any smartphone camera into a supermarket-grade barcode scanner, supports Voice AI billing in Hindi and English, manages retail inventories (size/color variants, pharmacy batch/expiry), tracks customer ledgers (Udhar Khata), and provides a 0% commission online store with instant UPI payments.
